# S M Hozaifa Hossain

> Semiconductor device & neuromorphic hardware researcher. EEE, University of Dhaka. CREST 2027 Fellow. Siemens EDA + IEEE EDS hackathon winner.

S M Hozaifa Hossain is a semiconductor device and neuromorphic hardware researcher from Bangladesh. An EEE graduate of the University of Dhaka (2026), he is an IT Consultant at Rahman Rahman Huq (formerly KPMG Bangladesh) and a CREST 2027 Research Fellow at Silicon River Bangladesh, advised by Dr. Mainul Hossain, and won the Siemens EDA HLS Hackathon 2026 and the IEEE EDS TCAD Hackathon 2026.

## Work

- IT Consultant, Rahman Rahman Huq (formerly KPMG Bangladesh), Dhaka, since September 2026. Consultant for the design and development of the firm's official website, rrh.com.bd (Next.js + Payload CMS), as client-side technical lead; wrote the content seeding pipeline.
